full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white ink illustration presses a frightened girl's face almost against the viewer. The head occupies nearly the entire frame, with a blunt dark fringe spanning the upper edge. Her two round eyes stare forward, the pupils black and tiny bright highlights reflected inside them. Deep semicircular hatch marks gather beneath each eye and along the eyelids. A small pale nose sits between broad zones of stippled gray, and the mouth is slightly open in shock. One slender hand crosses the lower right, its fingers resting against her cheek and covering part of the jaw. The knuckles and fingernails are carefully outlined with short lines and dark creases. Hair at the left edge fades into an almost solid black mass; behind the right side of her face the background also closes into darkness. The skin remains largely paper white, but hundreds of fine vertical and diagonal marks model the forehead, cheeks, nose, and hand. The ink gives no colored paint and no discernible setting. The viewpoint is frontal and very close, cropping the crown and lower chin to intensify the fixed gaze. A high, diffuse light leaves bright white in the eyes, nose ridge, and central face, while black hair and background create a severe enclosing shadow. The linework shifts from sharply outlined eye rims to dense, trembling hatches across softer planes. The overall composition is claustrophobic and alert, using extreme scale and the contrast of bare white paper with compressed black texture to hold the expression in place.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白墨线插图把惊惧女孩的面孔推得几乎贴近观者。头部占满大半画框，齐整深色刘海横过上缘。两只圆眼朝前凝视，瞳孔深黑，内有细小明亮反光。深色半圆排线聚在每只眼下和眼睑周围。小而浅色的鼻子位于大片点描灰调之间，嘴巴因震惊而微张。一只纤细手掌横过右下，手指贴住脸颊并盖住部分下颌。指节与指甲用短线和深色褶痕仔细勾出。左边缘的头发沉入几乎纯黑的体量；脸部右侧后方的背景也闭合成黑暗。皮肤大部分保留纸白，但数百道细竖线和斜线塑出额头、双颊、鼻子和手。图像没有彩色颜料，也没有可辨环境。视点正面而极近，头顶和下巴下部被裁掉，使凝固的目光更强。高处漫射光让眼睛、鼻梁和面部中央保有明亮白色，黑发和背景则形成严厉包围的阴影。线条从眼圈的锐利轮廓变化为柔软平面上密集颤动的排线。整体构图局促而警觉，以极端放大和裸白纸与压缩黑纹的对照锁住表情。
style_prompt_en: A stark monochrome ink illustration builds volume through very fine stipple, repeated directional hatching, and broad pockets of solid black. Enlarged pale forms are enclosed by dense dark texture, creating immediate visual pressure. Crisp circular contours and tiny white glints stand out against soft granular shading. The background compresses toward near-black at the sides, while the center holds raw paper white. Lighting is high and diffuse but the contrast is severe; shadows emerge from accumulated line rather than smooth gray wash. Close cropping and little spatial recession create a tense, intimate rhythm. The finish is meticulous, printed, and unsettling.
style_prompt_zh: 鲜明单色墨线插图用极细点描、反复方向排线和大片纯黑区建立体量。放大的浅色形状被密实深色肌理围住，产生即时视觉压力。清晰圆形轮廓与细小白色亮点从柔颗粒阴影中跳出。背景在两侧压向近黑，中心保留原纸白。光从高处漫射，但对比极强；阴影由线条累积，而非平滑灰色洗色形成。近距离裁切和极少空间退远创造紧张亲密的节奏。成品精细、具印刷感且令人不安。
theme_en: A wide-eyed girl's frightened close-up in black-and-white ink
theme_zh: 黑白墨线中睁大双眼的惊惧女孩特写
name: Junji Ito
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
